'''Argirin Darelos den Turamon''' is one of the [[Council of Nine]] in [[Illian]].

==Note==
Argirin Darelos only appears in ''[[The Wheel of Time Collectible Card Game]] and has not been mentioned in the books.

His full name, however, was included in [[The Wheel of Time Companion]].
